sourceObservations.detail: The armed and mutated dictionaries bind run, app PID, review session, capture, gate nonce, appearance, selected/legacy domains and omission choice. The mutated generation additionally binds the exact ordinary native target-changed checkpoint SHA256. Native reads are bounded to 4096 bytes through O_NOFOLLOW/O_NONBLOCK/O_CLOEXEC, regular single-link checks and exact string-only schema. UUID/PID/phase/domains/omit/checkpoint checks reject unrelated or stale relay metadata.

The publisher permits exactly armed then mutated at the run-specific runner/tmp filename. It preserves intended raw metadata before exclusive nofollow temporary creation, fsync and atomic replacement, verifies prior-generation bytes and same gate, and retains FAILED status/error on publication failure. The native reader also retains raw bytes and rejected observations. This is a finite test protocol, not a power-loss or adversarial concurrent-filesystem guarantee.

Native awaits armed metadata for 10 seconds, requires the exact131-character body with NSPredicate label equality, positive real alert/action geometry and hittable Recover/Not now, and captures the actual alert before writing the screenshot-bound UI marker. Host validates the real app gate/native binding before runner lookup or nonce use, reads the marker with raw-before-parse acquisition, verifies source/installed/protected/current/prior/fixed state, then acknowledges the app gate. A relay alone cannot authorize the known preference mutation.

Only after the ordinary target-changed boundary strict checks and acknowledgement does host publish mutated metadata with that checkpoint hash. Native rereads its own file with the same gate binding, requires the real whole alert again, records runner-file-relay transport/nonce and captures the after-mutation alert before the actual Recover tap. Old ready event sequence and eight ordinary host phases are retained; no fabricated ready/mutation/Recover success is introduced.

Existing synchronous final guards, session/appearance/selection/oldcapture identity, single-use mutation and cancellation/expiry remain the app authority.
